WITH m AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS joins, count(DISTINCT home_store_id) AS homes, min(valid_from) AS first_valid, min(join_date) AS jd FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT versions, joins, homes, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN first_valid <> jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_valid_ne_join FROM m GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id AS signup_store_id, valid_from,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn
  FROM dim_member),
cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id AS cur_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT f.signup_store_id, s.store_name, count(*) AS signups_first_version,
       sum(CASE WHEN c.cur_store_id = f.signup_store_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_as_current
FROM first_ver f JOIN cur c USING (member_id) LEFT JOIN s ON s.store_id = f.signup_store_id
WHERE f.rn = 1 AND f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH signup AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT s.home_store_id AS store_id, d.store_name, count(*) AS new_members
FROM signup s
JOIN (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d ON d.store_id = s.home_store_id
WHERE s.version_no = 1 AND s.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
